limitations.statement: C-001 and CT-1 are synthetic bounded scenario proofs, not production evidence.
The handoff is insufficient for DCF, three-statement, enterprise forecast, benchmark, or statistical claims.
Measures are specifications; consumer formulas, DAX, models, and visuals require separate governance.
DuckDB is a rebuildable read-only cache; canonical authority remains the verified source model.

synthetic_data_notice: Synthetic demonstration data only. Not production financial, assurance, audit, or decision evidence.
